settings.title: How this works
settings.content:
Nothing is for sale on this page. You pick the size you would take and leave an email, and that is the whole commitment — no card, no charge, no obligation to buy.

We read the sizes before we cut. A run only happens if enough people ask for it, and the size curve we order is the one registered here.

settings.title: What you are looking at
settings.content: This piece is under consideration. Photography and details are indicative until a release is confirmed.

settings.title: If it gets made
settings.content:
Everyone registered hears first, the morning it opens, before it reaches the collection pages.

If it does not get made, we write once to tell you, and that is the end of it.

settings.question: What fits inside?
settings.answer: It is designed to carry the essentials. Dimensions are listed in the product details above.

settings.question: How do I care for it?
settings.answer: Spot clean with a damp cloth and air dry. Keep it away from prolonged direct sunlight.

settings.question: Can I travel with it?
settings.answer: It is built with travel in mind. Check your airline's carry on limits against the dimensions in the product details.

settings.question: What should I pair it with?
settings.answer: The rest of the travel edit. Pack the Luxe Chino and a polo and you are ready.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer:
44 days to decide, starting the day it arrives. Exchanges and returns are free within Australia and New Zealand, returned in the satchel it came in.

Outside Australia and New Zealand you cover the return postage. Duties and taxes are included in every price, so nothing is owed on arrival.

settings.question: When will it arrive?
settings.answer: It has not been made yet, so there is no delivery date. Register the size you would take and you will hear first if it goes into production.
